{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Fruitcake Icon.png|320x320ox]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Fruitcake Icon.png|320x320ox]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= |uses= Restoring [[Heart]]s |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Fruitcakes''' are recurring [[Item]]s and [[Object]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Fruitcake|Fruitcakes|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} * {{AoC}} }} |- | ''No name is given'' | {{AoI}} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Fruitcakes are a type of [[Cake]] made by [[Cooking]] either an [[Apple]] or a [[Wildberry]], any [[Fruit]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], and [[Cane Sugar]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Regular versions of Fruitcake can be made by only using ingredients that do not grant any effects. They can be eaten to restore some [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. Fruitcakes make use of Fruits found all over [[Hyrule Kingdom]], and they are commonly used in celebrations. The first ''[[Castle Library Book]]'' outlines the recipe for Fruitcake, noting it to be a secret of the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]] and [[Princess Zelda]]'s favorite [[Meal]]. The [[Book]] suggests boiling two or more pieces of Fruit with Tabantha Wheat and Cane Sugar for a while. This dish is known to help clear one's head and help with focus, which Zelda apparently took advantage of while she researched [[Ancient Technology]]. As part of the "[[A Royal Recipe]]" [[Side Quest]], Link can give [[Gotter]] at [[Riverside Stable]] a Fruitcake. After eating it, he at first describes it as having a refreshing aroma, reminiscent of galloping across the planes on horseback. However, he states that undersells the complexity of the dish, saying it fills him with the intensity of being seen by a [[Guardian]]. Gotter calls Fruitcake an elegant dish and explains he never thought he would taste something so thrilling. As a reward, he will give Link a [[Silver Rupee]]. Several different variations of Fruitcake can be made, based on both the kind of Fruit used and whether any additional ingredients are added: * '''Chilly Fruitcake''': Made using [[Hydromelon]]s or other chilly ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] temporarily if they are consumed. * '''Electro Fruitcake''': Made using [[Voltfruit]]s or other electric ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Enduring Fruitcake''': Made using enduring ingredients. If they are eaten, they will completely refill and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Energizing Fruitcake''': Made using energizing ingredients. When eaten, they will replenish a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Fruitcake''': Made using [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]] or other hasty ingredients. Eating them will increase Link's movement speed for a short period of time. * '''Hearty Fruitcake''': Made using [[Hearty Durian]]s or other hearty ingredients. Eating these cakes will completely heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Fruitcake''': Made using [[Mighty Bananas]] or other mighty ingredients. If eaten, they increase the power of Link's attacks for a short time. * '''Sneaky Fruitcake''': Made using sneaky ingredients. When eaten, these Cakes will increase Link's [[Stealth]] for a short period of time. * '''Spicy Fruitcake''': Made using [[Spicy Pepper]]s or other spicy ingredients. When consumed, they grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] temporarily. * '''Tough Fruitcake''': Made using tough ingredients. Eating one will temporarily boost Link's defense. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The recipe for Fruitcake is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Afternoon Tea at Hyrule Castle]]". It is made using four [[Wildberry|Wildberries]], four [[Hydromelon]]s, four [[Tabantha Wheat]], and four [[Cane Sugar]]s. However, it can be lowered to three of each ingredient through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Battle]], [[Enemy|Enemies]] will have a 30% higher chance of dropping [[Material]]s. As part of the Quest "[[Made with Love]]", [[Terrako]] wishes to make a Fruitcake for [[Zelda]] to show its appreciation for her. Once it has the ingredients, Terrako presents her with the Fruitcake, and the two spend the afternoon with each other. If Zelda is the current active [[Warrior]] when Fruitcake is chosen, she will state how much she loves it. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== As part of the [[Quest]] "[[Something Sweet]]", [[Lenalia]] helps [[Zelda]] make a Fruitcake for [[Ardi]]. Lady Zelda seems to think Lady Ardi is having trouble adapting to the rigors of chiefdom, and wants to give her something sweet to calm her nerves. Hearing this, I immediately offered to help find the necessary ingredients.

Lady Ardi was overjoyed at receiving the fruitcake Lady Zelda made for her. Afterward, she said it brought her a welcome respite from her duties as chief, while also improving the effectiveness of her training.
